text: ポケモンは　５のしまの　そうこだ！

structure.en: are (in) the warehouse on Five Island!

patterns.name: 〜は〜だ
patterns.span: ポケモンは　５のしまの　そうこだ
patterns.explanation: Here だ does not mean 'equals': it stands in for 'are at', pointing to the place. ポケモンは　５のしまの　そうこだ = 'the Pokémon are in the warehouse on Five Island'.
